Once I received an item that was completely broken, of course I registered this, but the seller was completely unresponsive. I had uploaded all the requested photos and the item was just clearly broken in transit. The money ended up being released to the seller. I had a similar incident happen as the seller as well. It’s sad because when it worked I genuinely enjoyed using the app, but after these experiences I barely come on here anymore and will most likely not sell any further items. reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing and unacceptable customer service.

I purchased an iPhone 18 Pro through Vinted, and what arrived was an EMPTY PACKAGE. Yes, an empty package. No phone, despite paying for one.

I contacted Vinted BEFORE the reporting deadline expired and explained that I was abroad and that my sister wouldn’t be able to inspect the package until November 1. Their own customer support told me that I could report an issue on November 1 if the order was still open. I relied on their guidance.

When my sister finally inspected the parcel, there was no phone inside. I immediately contacted support, only to be told that the transaction had been completed and they could no longer help me.

So let me get this straight: I paid for an expensive phone, received an empty box, contacted support in advance, followed the instructions they gave me, and still ended up losing my money?

Now they’ve supposedly opened an investigation, but getting an actual response or reaching a human representative has become nearly impossible. My order says completed, the original support chat has disappeared, and there is no clear way to follow up.

This is absolutely unacceptable. Buyer protection means nothing if customers cannot rely on the support team when something goes wrong.

I am extremely disappointed with Vinted. I would strongly advise anyone considering purchasing expensive electronics on this platform to think twice. An empty package should never be treated as a completed purchase

reviews.title: Weird
reviews.text:
A Marketplace Run by Bots, Not Customer Service

Vinted is run by finicky, bizarre, temperamental and frequently incorrect bots. Getting genuine help, meaningful answers or an actual resolution to a problem seems almost impossible.

The app might work perfectly well when everything goes smoothly, but the moment something goes wrong, you discover just how inadequate its customer support really is.

You're met with automated responses, irrelevant copy-and-paste answers, circular conversations and decisions that often seem completely disconnected from the actual circumstances. Trying to explain a situation to these systems feels like talking to a brick wall. You can explain, clarify, provide evidence and appeal, yet somehow end up right back where you started.

There appears to be very little accountability, common sense or willingness to properly investigate individual cases. Automated systems seem perfectly capable of flagging, restricting and penalising users, but when it comes to correcting mistakes or providing meaningful assistance, suddenly nobody seems capable of helping.

A marketplace needs more than algorithms. It needs people.

Real customer service means listening, understanding context, exercising reasonable judgement and taking responsibility when things go wrong. Vinted desperately needs to recognise that automated responses are not a substitute for competent human support.

It's incredibly frustrating to use a platform where you feel you're entirely on your own

reviews.title: SCAM!!! Stay Away!
reviews.text: We ordered a couple of things off this app and ended up losing over $300. It was suspicious after our order’s shipping label was created and scanned in at two different locations (one created in California and scanned in Queens, and one created in Virginia and scanned in the Bronx). Then, when the first package arrived it was a “thank you” note and a recipe card. Then when my wife tried to file a complaint, the Vinted representative she had a chat with told her that her account had been blocked for “illicit activity” and the order had been marked as delivered (which we did not do and is only supposed to be done by the recipient after the order is verified so they can release the funds to the seller, but somehow it had been done). And then when they gave her their mailing address for litigation or complaints, the address they gave isn’t even in the US…it’s in Lithuania. So maybe it’s only some items that are scams, but I know for a fact we did not. I have also seen multiple posts about children’s toys with descriptions about children suggesting that they are trafficking kids. So all in all, a word of caution to anyone who has or is considering downloading this app, be careful what you buy or even click on, apparently. Hopefully this review doesn’t get removed and I hope people are actually spared the trouble or having to deal with this. And most of all I hope they aren’t actually doing anything with kids and if they are I hope they get caught.

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: I don't know who the bigger scammers are here—the sellers or the app itself. You pay for buyer protection insurance on every purchase, and everything is fine as long as the order goes smoothly; but if you receive a counterfeit product, you’d better pray for help, because Vinted certainly won't provide it. The item I received was missing the certificate of authenticity printed on the box—which is the most conclusive proof—yet even after sending a thousand photos, they claimed there wasn't enough evidence! I had to pay for the return shipping myself, despite having already paid for buyer protection insurance. Supposedly, if an item is a fake, you’re supposed to get a refund without needing to return the item; I was always willing to return it, but I expected the seller or the app to cover the shipping costs. The insurance is clearly just a way for the app to make money, making this a very unsafe platform. I DO NOT RECOMMEND IT TO ANYONE! I’d suggest using Facebook Marketplace, eBay, or Poshmark instead. Plus, the support chat is ridiculously bad. They just repeat the same thing over and over, and on top of that, you have to run a marathon inside the app just to find out how to access the chat. Honestly, this app is terrible. Don't buy anything here unless you want to get scammed.

reviews.title: Permanent ban despite clear “sold as seen” disclosure on a previously disputed card
reviews.text:
I sold a Japanese Mega Gengar ex SAR card on Vinted. In the listing I was completely transparent: a previous buyer had already returned the card after questioning its authenticity. I therefore sold it strictly “as seen” on the photos provided, with no authenticity guarantee, and clearly stated that buyers should inspect every photo carefully before purchasing. The listing also said the sale was final with no returns.
The buyer bought the card, then raised an authenticity concern. I cooperated fully with Vinted’s process, provided the original listing details, and sent additional close-up photos when requested. I do not have an original receipt and never claimed the card was guaranteed authentic.
Despite the clear prior disclosure and my full cooperation, Vinted permanently banned my account for “selling counterfeit items.” No real consideration appears to have been given to the fact that the risk was openly disclosed before the sale took place.
This decision feels extremely one-sided. Sellers who are transparent about potential issues are still treated the same as those who deliberately sell fakes with no warning. Once the permanent ban is applied, there is little meaningful chance of a proper review.
I would strongly caution other sellers: even if you disclose previous authenticity concerns and sell an item strictly as seen, Vinted can still permanently ban your account if a buyer later claims the item is fake.

reviews.title: Banned without any reason and evidence.
reviews.text:
I was permanently banned from Vinted after listing authentic Nike shoes. I supplied clear proof of purchase and authenticity (receipts/invoices, original tags, packaging details, and close-up photos of logos, stitching, and labels), yet the account was still banned for alleged “fraudulent activity / counterfeit items.”
What made it worse is that every appeal and reply I received was the exact same generic AI-generated response. No specific feedback on what part of the evidence was insufficient, no reference to the documents I uploaded, and no indication that a human had actually looked at the case. It felt completely automated and dismissive.
Vinted’s own policy says sellers should keep and provide proof of authenticity for branded items (especially popular targets for counterfeits like Nike), and that appeals will be reviewed. In practice, the system appears to rely heavily on automated detection that can flag genuine second-hand items, followed by template replies that give no real justification or path to resolution.
This left me locked out with no meaningful way to challenge the decision. If you sell branded sneakers or similar items, be prepared that even solid documentation may not protect you from an automated ban, and support may not escalate beyond copy-paste AI messages.

I understand for big packages, but even little, mini keychains, I’ve seen for some reason have shipping that’s 3.99, plus whatever additional fees it decides to slap you with. It’s frustrating because I’ve recommended this site to so many people who NEED that affordability to have these sorts of nice things, and now my only pitch for them to use this site is sort of done for. It’s like the site has suddenly lost its only appeal to me, which was the shipping costs. It’s still fairly affordable; but with the additional fees, it’d make those small little impulse purchases you get for maybe two-three dollars, become ten, to twelve dollars. In addition, there’s NO regulation to scams on this website. Every single minute there’s someone using someone else’s photos from an entirely different website, and trying to pass it off as their’s, and reports do not work at all. So many times I’ve seen such frustratingly obvious scams, reported them, and watched no action be taken.

reviews.title: Sellers Beware!
reviews.text: I wanted to like Vinted, but my experience as a seller has been incredibly frustrating. After a “manual” review, the decision was upheld, but I was never given a specific reason why the item was considered fake. What really destroyed my confidence in the process was a second listing. Being accused of selling counterfeit products is a serious matter, and sellers deserve clear explanation and consistent reviews before penalties are applied. I fully support removing counterfeit items from the platform, but the current process feels arbitrary and lack transparency. If you’re a seller, beware that legitimate listings can be removed, account restrictions can be imposed, and you may never receive a meaningful explanation as to why. There is a lot of potential here, but the seller experience needs significant improvement.

reviews.title: Aussies be warned! You can be unfairly banned due to poor AI systems
reviews.text: As an Aussie, downloaded the app made 15 sales within a week! To then after 9 days on the app without warning I woke up to my account being “permanently banned” due to “not authentic” listing. Mind you this listing was not a designer brand, it was an Australian Fast fashion brand. I had the option to appeal and with horrible customer service provided a 48 hour deadline to provide the same information to prove my fast fashion product was authentic. It’s unfortunate, it’s a great service as a seller and buyer. But it’s obvious their AI systems are ruining the platform very rapidly. For longevity, long term investment and less anxiety as a seller stay away.

reviews.title: glitch
reviews.text: there has been a glitch for well over a week when none of the tracking is working, but you were still getting messages from vintage to tell you to post items that you have posted days ago, their response from customer service is AI or copy and paste. They’re not actually listening to what we’re saying and it’s very hard to get paid for your items. no updates on when do you think it’s gonna be fixed either

reviews.title: I tried
reviews.text: I can’t say I didn’t try to be patient. I did everything they asked of me with this requests to open up new issue reports every single time the order got cancelled. But I found the shipping label kept getting cancelled for the sellers as it was telling them I had issues with my location being wrong. Although it was right and I’m not sure if it was just broken. I tried to communicate this to the Vinted team and repeatedly got annoyed and ignored and got told in the end there’s nothing they can do unless I purchase something and make another request. Yeah so no thanks, they ended the conversation off with. “Our decision is final” what to ignore my request to approve my location as real?

reviews.title: Don’t bother wasting your time
reviews.text: Don’t bother. My account was permanently banned for selling “counterfeit goods” even though they were completely genuine. I provided receipts and photos to Vinted support but still received no response. I’m now locked out of my account and can’t get in touch with buyers to ship items they’ve purchased all because they have a faulty AI flagging genuine products as counterfeit. Terrible system and poor customer service. Don’t bother wasting your time

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service Ever!
reviews.text: I had been using Vinted for the last 12 months.  No issues, selling not buying and had great reviews from buyers.  I put up a pair of New Balance Trainers for sale and suddenly my account was permanently banned.  Reason getting vent was suspicion of selling counterfeit goods.  I had the receipt which showed a picture of the trainers which I uploaded and emailed.  All I got back were automated emails and emails to say someone will be in touch.  Needless to say no one came back to me.  I emailed again last week and got a reply to say sorry that that was their decision and that was final answer.  I was so annoyed and upset I don’t understand what they are playing at.  I’ve seen a lot of reviews online having the same issues.  WORST COMPANY EVER!!!  AVOID !!!!!

reviews.title: Don’t bother - They’ll just ban you for no reason.
reviews.text:
EDIT: After days of back and forth with customer support, I’m completely unable to use the platform and outright banned for literally doing nothing. This platform is a joke. Thanks for wasting my time. It’s so strange to punish users who have literally done absolutely nothing (and I’m not exaggerating).


I haven’t even had the chance to use the app because, for some reason, the sign-up process is proving to be near impossible.

When I first created my account, I was instantly banned for seemingly no reason. Literally only just hit ‘create account’, and then I was instantly banned. 

Contacted support and I was pleasantly surprised they got back to me within a day - however, once I continued to the app… my region was set to France. Literally pressed Australia during the sign up process AND VERIFIED an Australian phone number. Contacted Vinted support again and they just told me there was nothing they could do, and that I would have to delete my account and start the process again.

I’m very disappointed. If the instant-ban is just a round-about way to confirm the user is a human, there are far easier ways to do that. Extremely inefficient and inconvenient 🙁

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: I was on Vinted for three days and I got wrongfully banned. I was trying to sell an old lululemon shirt that had just been sitting in my closet. Finally I get a sale! The next day my account is permanently banned with no actual evidence of anything. I try to appeal but I can’t because the ridiculous app doesn’t even allow me to click on buttons because I am banned. The money I made? Still pending. I couldn’t even print the shipping label because I am banned- so the poor lady who ordered would’ve received nothing if I hadn’t taken a screenshot before. I absolutely do not like this app, it’s poor customer service and support is just another one of its awful qualities. Depop is and always will be better and safer to sell on. I have been selling for 2 years and never have I ever dealt with such an unprofessional and awful app. One star is HEAVILY deserved especially because I promoted this app sadly with the intention that it is safe to use and it was recommended to me. As I conducted more research, I am NOT the only one this has happened to- several people have dealt with the same issue. You cannot ask for peoples social security and bank information and then ban them the next day- unacceptable and I hope this awful app gets shut down.

reviews.title: Beware fakes being ignored and then being banned for a genuine item
reviews.text: Previously quit Vinted in disgust after buying some Birkenstocks that turned out to clearly be fake. Vinted were not interested and would take no action against the seller as I hadn’t noticed within the 2 day period. After a few months had got over it and set up a new account and thought I would try selling an old POC helmet for cheap. I had never sold before and followed all the rules. Out of nowhere couldn’t access my account as have been banned for counterfeit/fraudulent activity. Bit of internet research suggests that I’m not alone with this seemingly random blocking.  Customer service was always very poor, but now it looks like AI is making these decisions itself. Tried to appeal but 2 days later nothing. At least I could mark my purchases as arrived so the couple of things I have bought will allow payment to the sellers. It’s upsetting and disappointing, especially as I always made a point of helping the community by reporting obvious fake listings (typically for Pioneer DJ mixers). Real shame, as I have bought some really cool things at great prices, however when things go wrong you aren’t very well protected compared to eBay. Pretty poor that the AI isn’t doing its job properly and the irony is not lost on me, for leaving due to fakes and being banned for a fake fake!!!

reviews.title: They make it hard for sellers.
reviews.text:
As a buyer, 5stars so far, but I haven’t had any issues that need resolved yet… 
As a seller, way less satisfied. Online photos are not allowed, even to show colors or swatches, etc., but if you post anything opened, even if it is new and unused, they will delete your hard work & ban you from selling for an indeterminate amount of time, since mine said until June 30, 2026, & it is almost August 1, & I am still “temporarily banned.” Support response times are awful, & they are not open to negotiation or explanation on anything. The clear inside cover & outer sleeve for an unused eyeshadow palette were clearly visible & it was deemed “used.” I posted eyeshadow sticks with the new box and clear photos of both the original box and the smooth untouched surface, to show both the color and lack of usage. Deemed “used” by Vinted & was deleted. Same thing with a new face powder where you can see the original sticker over the sifter holes. Ridiculous standards. They don’t even allow secondhand furs, which I feel makes greater use of something that has already been made, & prevents more firsthand purchases of animal products. Just my opinion. Reminds me of early Mercari & definitely needs some work. Could be a great platform for sellers & moneymaker for the creators, but they need to make some changes. Big fan of the 0 seller fees & especially the free shipping, even though I know it won’t last forever. But it’s hard to enjoy no seller fees when you get banned for long periods for doing

reviews.title: Poor Customer Service with No Payout in Sight
reviews.text: While Vinted has been celebrated for its free shipping promotion here in Australia, I must say Depop is much more seller friendly. There are genuine live agents who read your support messages, whereas Vinted sends automated responses that do not address the original request for help. Secondly, Vinted has held onto my payments beyond its stated 2-day window and offers no resolution in sight. This is frustrating as it assumes user error rather than working out its own system glitches. I will be delisting my items and sticking to Depop.

reviews.title: Zero Flexibility and No Opportunity to Resolve Honest Mistakes
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Vinted’s moderation process. I listed an item that I genuinely did not believe was counterfeit. Instead of giving me a warning or allowing me to remove the listing, my account was investigated for nearly two weeks. After that, Vinted concluded the item was counterfeit, permanently suspended my account, and even blacklisted my phone number, preventing me from ever creating another account.

What frustrates me most isn’t that they reviewed the item—it’s that there was no reasonable opportunity to correct what I believed was an honest mistake. At no point was I given the option to simply delete the listing or receive a warning before such a severe penalty was imposed. The process felt inflexible and disproportionately harsh.

If Vinted’s policy is to permanently ban users without first considering intent or offering a chance to resolve a first-time issue, then the platform should make that abundantly clear. I understand the importance of protecting buyers from counterfeit items, but there should also be room for fairness and good-faith mistakes. Unfortunately, my experience left me feeling like I was treated as guilty from the start, with no meaningful opportunity to make things right.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I was sent the wrong order by mistake and submitted a report on the day the parcel arrived (15th). I was then told by customer service to provide photos of the package/labels within 48 hours so that they could process a return. I provided the requested information within 48 hours (17th), but was refused a refund on the 22nd as they “didn’t receive the information on time”. I then provided screenshots of my messages, the date and the response that they would review the issue. The still refused to provide a refund as the period for review has now passed despite the information being provided within the timeframe. Terrible experience.

reviews.title: Absolutely disgraceful service, destroyed my sentimental item and then blocked my account.
reviews.text:
I’m absolutely appalled by the way that Vinted handled my situation. I want to warn every single person not  to not trust to sell anything of sentimental value on this app. I sold the watch with great sentimental value, irreplaceable to me. I took every possible care packing it: fully wrapped in bubble wrap, secured inside a sturdy box, i’m placed inside a jewelry pouch for extra security. Despite this, it arrived broken with the handles no longer attached to the watch And it’s beyond repair. 
When I reached out to resolve the issue fairly, Vinted did not offer help, they did not investigate, they didn’t even have the decency reply. instead, they blocked my account completely with zero warning and no explanation at all. no email no notification was given at all.
All this time the buyer was waiting frustrated, waiting for a resolution, while I was left feeling powerless about the situation. The item was ruined through no fault of mine.
This is in fact the worst platform and customer service I have dealt with. they do not care about your items. They do not care about your feelings. they certainly do not care about doing the right thing. i’m genuinely heartbroken and furious. they destroyed something that was precious to me, then swept me aside like I didnt exist. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.title: No help for lost parcels
reviews.text:
WARNING: I placed an order with Vinted before it official called out the tracking issues it is currently having and they have abdicated any responsibility to help me find my parcel and making it my fault. Vinted’s app told me that my parcel from the UK was delivered to Australia IN 3 days. I have had to work with the seller and Vinted’s delivery partner to find my parcel. The saga is still continuing as is Vinted’s tracking issues. 

Definitely recommend being aware of this before buying from Vinted.

reviews.title: Terrible Vinted experience
reviews.text: I downloaded this app to try to sell some of my old items. One day I put a Target branded clog shoes on my account. I labeled them as target branded and didn’t mention a name brand once. Within the matter of 5 minutes, my account was blocked for “Fraudulent Activity”  and more than 30+ orders were cancelled. My buyers who bought my items are furious and are messaging me incredibly obscene messages about their order being cancelled. The kicker is I couldn’t even reply to them and tell them the issue going on and vinted didn’t even explain to these customers the issue. I email vinted through their support email. I waited about three days without a response and put through a help response through the app. After more than a week I received a response to my email and the message on the vinted app basically stating it’s being reviewed and I will have to wait, when I DID NOTHING WRONG! I have threatened to take legal action with this matter and still the customer service team neglects to do a thing about it. The lack and quality of customer service you receive from the Vinted team is utterly unacceptable. I don’t even want to sell my items on the app if I eventually do get ahold of my account again because the way I have been treated like I have done something very wrong is ridiculous. This app is a joke and the customer service is terrible. ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE APP!

reviews.title: Terrible postage system with ZERO customer support!
reviews.text: New to Zinted Australia, first UK order suspended due to item being marked as delivered when it hit NSW Australia Post depot. Customer claimed item not received even though it was only 2 days since posted. Other UK order delayed. Not accepting offers from the UK until Vinted sort it out. Seems they didn’t really think the postage system through. And trying to get customer support is non existent except for AI bot answers. So I’m declining all UK offers to avoid a hassle, do not really enjoying the Vinted experience!

reviews.title: Horrible, don’t join
reviews.text:
I joined and listed 4 items. My 4th item was a pair of shoes I bought at Costco that didn’t fit. I got them so cheap, thought I’d sell them to make a few bucks from them. An automatic permanently banned message popped up saying due to fraud, and these shoes were counterfeit. WHAT! 

These were Tretorn sneakers from Costco I was selling for like $25-$30, they were my own pictures and description. It makes no sense. No item pulled or need a supervisor to look over this listing. But a permanently banned, can’t see anything on the account anymore. 

I emailed and got a generic response. I replied back and also asked them to delete my account and info since I want nothing to do with them after this.I received another generic response and asked me for more of my information including my id and cc info. Definitely will not be giving them any information they don’t already have. I emailed back and forth a few times and each time was a very generic response that didn’t answer my question or solve the issue. Anyway I have been on Poshmark since 2019 and never had one issue with any of my items. Can’t believe I was banned on here the first day. Just glad it was after only 4 items and I didn’t waist anymore of my time and effort here.

reviews.title: Fast but packaging wasn’t good enough
reviews.text: Theres no problem with the seller in particular as the item was shipped very fast. However, considering I bought a makeup pallet there was no effort in trying to prevent damage while being shipped, . Maybe some bubble wrap or additional wrapping would be much more effective instead of posting with no protection. I’ve fixed it to some capacity as luckily only two of the swatches were broken up. Besides that, Thanks so much for the order and the swift response.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text:
I downloaded Vinted today and my account was permanently blocked after listing a pair of genuine Adidas trainers. They claimed the item was not authentic based only on the photos I uploaded, without giving me the opportunity to provide additional pictures or explain anything.

The worst part is that my entire account was permanently banned over a single listing. There was no fair review process and no chance to prove the item was genuine.

I understand the need to fight counterfeit products, but permanently banning new users without properly investigating is unacceptable. Very disappointing experience. I won’t be using this app again, and I cannot recommend it.

reviews.title: Great sellers. Terrible customer support.
reviews.text: I’ve loved my purchases. The sellers are great, and the prices remind me of the old days on eBay. But Vinted has unrealistic expectations on package acceptance with no variables. You must accept a package within a couple days, and you are out of luck when out of town. They accept the package for you after the deadline, and you have no recourse if it’s damaged. Sellers get over a week to mail a package and can also mark their accounts as out of town/away. Buyers have no options, and good luck getting an answer from support. This would be 4 stars (just because the app is not top notch) if it weren’t for their expectation that people sit at home constantly waiting on packages. Or they don’t want you to buy things if you might be gone. I had the death of a parent. There is no way to plan that, and I had to deal with traveling across the country, making arrangements, writing obituary, planning services, and still deal with Vinted telling me I had to accept the package. It’s a really major oversight if you want repeat customers. I have spent a fortune on their app, but there is not any consideration for real life.

reviews.title: Terrible AI Regulation
reviews.text:
I’ve used Vinted for years and was extremely disappointed by how my account was handled. One of my listings was repeatedly flagged by what appeared to be an automated system. Every time I tried to appeal, I received generic AI responses instead of being able to explain the situation to a real person.

My account was then permanently banned for alleged “fraudulent activity, such as selling counterfeit items,” yet I was never told which evidence was relied upon or given a meaningful opportunity to respond. The support chat was simply closed.

Whether the original decision was right or wrong, the lack of transparency and inability to speak to a human is unacceptable. A permanent ban should involve a fair review and a clear explanation, not automated template responses.

Until Vinted improves its customer support and appeal process, I can’t recommend the platform.

reviews.title: worst customer service
reviews.text: Had the worst experience using this app. You are gonna think you will be protected because you pay for buyer’s protection everytime, but unfortunately when you actually need help, you are never gonna hear from them. I reached out to them countless times, tried everything and did everything right, yet never got the right resolution, if i had the means i would have pursued legal options. Done with this app. Horrible service.

reviews.title: 0 stars: Banned
reviews.text: Made an account to sell unwanted items. Created 2 posts of Labubus but ‘hide’ them as I wanted to put more post up all together. While doing homework I got an email stating “We’ve permanently banned your account from Vinted because of fraudulent activity, such as selling counterfeit items”. I was confused as I hid my items and haven’t put anything up yet, tried to resolve the issue through the app but I have to submit an appeal. If I can give it 0 star rating I would, even negative stars I would as I wasted my time. It said to post original photos (no online photos) in which I did take photos of my items and yet here we are. In the email it also stated “This content was detected automatically” which is dumb cause instead of actually making sure it’s my photos asking for more proof for like videos and etc it just automatically bans. Buh in my description I even stated that I have all the Labubu cards in protective cases which helps verify they are real. Then it says “Creating multiple accounts is not allowed, so any further accounts you create will also be banned”. I would never download the app again or recommend the app to anyone and have them waste their time.

reviews.title: BEWARE ! AVOID at all costs!
reviews.text: Absolute worst experience I have ever had on any platform and worst customer service ever (and that includes the times I went to the DMV). I do NOT recommend this app for those wanting to avoid getting their money taken out of their account even after contacting Vinted to resolve my issue that I never got my item. I supplied all the evidence such as screenshots , usps tracking showing it was never delivered, I opened a ticket, reported the sellers chat with me due to no response. Even went to the usps office to ask about my package and confirmed I was being scammed. The seller had put a modified label with their address on it but with the barcode correctly pulling up after scanning as my address so the item would route to my home,  but luckily the mail carrier saw something was odd about the label address not matching the barcode after scanning. The package was tiny and could not possibly hold my item so usps refused to deliver it to me and returned to sender. Normally this is where any good platform’s customers service would step in to issue a refund because the tracking from usps now shows as returned back to sender. Not with Vinted !!!! They accused me of putting my address wrong during my order despite me telling them past orders have always gone through when I have purchased before! Then they ignored me and gave me the run around when I asked for a refund . They gave me BS about needing time to further investigate! I said what is there left to do. I sent them everything

reviews.title: Their support is terrible
reviews.text: I reported a seller as a scammer because they tried to sell me a Coach bag as authentic. The bag didn't have a serial number, and support told me there wasn't enough to ban the seller. So I posted a picture of a Coach bag with photos of the original packaging, serial number, and original internal labels, and they didn't accept my post, saying it looked counterfeit, and they even restricted my account. The funniest thing is that I bought the bag on Vinted itself. They are ridiculous and inefficient. I don't recommend them at all.

reviews.title: Allegedly, they got listing that R selling kids. The problem is Vinted isn’t doing anything about it
reviews.text: The story isn’t clear, but what I’ve gotten is people would post listings “1-5 yr old” originally, I saw satire post about how they are selling children, people were just saying they’d accidentally list stuffed animals as an age range and they were saying people are selling children on vinted as a joke. However, over time people started getting actually worried because the listing would become more specific. “Virgin” “Alive” etc, things that hint a real child. I personally think that those were just gross people making more convincing post that weren’t real. The thing is, it raises concerns… what if people are selling child porn or real children? Vinted hasn’t done much about it, I mean, they’d said they’re looking into it… but anyone can say they are looking into something and then continue to do nothing about it. They should make a post about what’s happening, to show concern and raise awareness, but they haven’t. And I’m sure they can review listings or at least have the system catch certain words so they can review those listings. I’m sure many post are fake and completely made up, but it doesn’t make it any less gross and concerning that they are being so quiet about “looking into it.”

reviews.title: Wrongly Fully Banned/Not a Trustworthy Selling App
reviews.text: I just downloaded and started with Vinted about a week ago and I was doing well with my first set of sales but then I was banned due to Vinted claiming I posted a counterfeit dress. Not sure why because I posted all tags and tickets. It was a brand new dress I purchased from Macys years ago sitting in the back of my closet. I was banned for about 3 days and missed out on all the sales from the free shipping promo they were running. My account was cleared but the item was still removed without any reason. I was concerned that I wasn’t going to receive my money from all the sales I shipped out right before being banned since no one received anything yet. I just feel this was a bit weird and I no longer trust this site. I’ve never had that happen in all the reselling apps I’ve used and I use quite a few. I worked in retail management and acquired a large wardrobe and need to downsize so nothing I own is counterfeit unless Macys is selling counterfeit products. Just beware if you’re going to use this site, I’ve seen people talk about their overly aggressive AI fraud monitoring, which can really negatively impact your sales seeing as it takes awhile for them to review your appeal and there’s absolutely no way of speaking/chatting with any real person

reviews.text:
I have been selling on vinted for some time and occasionally i would be flagged for selling “counterfeit” items (keep in mind these were real authentic items)
zero evidence was provided and i couldnt appeal it, finally after my ability to post an item was removed for a 4th time i was permanently banned from vinted

reviews.title: Run by flawed and incompetent AI, Beware!
reviews.text: I created my account 2 weeks ago to sell items as I am attempting to downsize. I barely used the app other than to list items to sell and casually browse items the app recommends to me. But then I made my first sale and when I logged onto the app to view details, a notification  that I was banned popped up. I received no warnings, no flags. I listed 4 items. All genuine items with clear and exact details on conditions, I used all original photos that I took. I messaged no one other than to counter offer using Vinted’s default counter offer feature so I am 100% sure all my activities on the app did not violate any terms in the T&C. I browsed online forums to see if others experienced the same thing and apparently this is common since the app is run by AI. I can’t do anything other than to use the in app feature to contact Vinted and so far I’m only receiving bot autoreplies. I hope the buyer received their money back because I got an email that the funds they paid are currently on hold but I have no way of contacting them or knowing if the order was cancelled. Based on what others have said in online forums, buyers and sellers alike have had funds stolen from them by Vinted when they were banned or blocked by Vinted’s flawed AI. Be careful with your money on this app.

reviews.title: Nothing but scammers
reviews.text: Customer service atrocious if they even bother to answer at all. If you are a decent person trying to sell used items for a fair price don’t go any where near this website. Most the listings are made by fake profiles selling fake stuff that their AI system doesn’t pick up but you sell a brand name and boom you’ll have your account blocked. No accountability for items damaged during transit, as a seller you will be the one footing the bill for the product and you won’t get any money, don’t waste your time. Don’t believe me check the Facebook groups or TikTok’s videos about what I’m saying.

reviews.title: Bans genuine people, keeps scammers
reviews.text: I’ve used Vinted for years, but they have dropped the ball this time. My partner and I sell Pokemon cards, we buy boxes and packs from shops like Sports Direct, rip the packs and then sell the cards we don’t want. Recently my partner and many other people, were able to get Chaos Rising a few days before it fully dropped due to selected stores having an early release. We assume, someone thought they were fake cards as Chaos Rising hadn’t dropped officially yet and reported a normal common base card. Vinted have taken 3 weeks to come back to us with their review, and despite having proof of the cards, the ETBs they came from and receipt of purchase, they’ve banned us for fraudulent activity. A real card they’ve banned us over. On top of this, I found an account selling fake cards as real, I reported a fake golden Hisuian Arcanine card and sent two screenshots of people leaving reviews on this person saying their purchases were actually fake and yet Vinted came back and said it DIDNT go against their guidelines. So they have banned someone selling real cards, but actively kept a genuine scammer despite reviews saying this person has scammed customers before. Normally I wouldn’t leave a review like this, but my partner is disabled and they really enjoyed this hobby and the extra small income really helped out, which Vinted have taken from us over a genuine item. Shame on Vinted, protecting scammers.

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: You have absolutely no protection with this app. I was sent fake apple product. Realised three days later when I rang apple. Because it wasn’t within two days had no protection. Husband sold an item for €170. Box damaged but contents was perfect, as seen in photos the buyer themselves posted to Vinted. Vinted refunded them and let them keep the perfect item worth €170. No protection. Impossible to contact separately, no help with issues. I was left abisive feedback too. Vinted agreed it was abusing and blocked the user for a few days- but refuse to remove abusivr feedback. Unless you’re buying and selling for a couple euro - avoid.

reviews.title: Poor support
reviews.text:
Vinted’s delivery/support system is honestly one of the most frustrating customer experiences I’ve had.

I paid nearly €8 for shipping plus buyer protection, and my parcel has been stuck with no updates for days. The tracking stopped at “Departed sort facility,” An Post has no record of it, and nobody can tell me where the package actually is.

The carrier refuses to help because “contact the retailer.”
Vinted support only sends automated replies telling me to wait.
No human support, no investigation details, no accountability.

Meanwhile, parcels ordered later are already arriving before this one.

What makes this especially frustrating is the absurd waiting period. Instead of proactively investigating missing parcels, the system just extends the deadline for weeks while the buyer sits there with zero information. By the time the parcel arrives — if it even arrives — the entire excitement of the purchase is gone.

The worst part is not even the delay itself.
It’s the complete lack of transparency and the feeling that nobody is actually handling the situation.

If you’re going to charge for buyer protection and international shipping, there should at least be real customer support and meaningful tracking visibility.

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: Everyone on this app tells you that if you want to buy something, you need to text a phone number. And vinted does absolutely nothing about it. Most of the sellers cancel orders because they don’t want you to purchase the item through the website. They want you to text the number, and when you do. They tell you to send the money via Cash app, Venmo, PayPal. Sometimes they have a Nintendo DS is going for $85. I think we all collectively know that that is a scam. There are also cameras that are trending right now that go for four to $600 or more and people tell you to go to a website and it’s like a sketchy website and purchase there. People lowball you so badly for your stuff. If you are asking 250, people will offer you 140, 120, 80 bucks even. There should be a threshold as to how low somebody can offer you you constantly get notifications asking you to upload. But nobody wants to buy anything that’s over six dollars. You also get messages from people asking you to collaborate with their companies and it sellers that have zero followers and zero sales and they are following zero people. This app needs a lot of work still. And it won’t be good until Vinted fixes at least that part.

reviews.title: Allows Scammers, Dropshipping & general poor customer service.
reviews.text:
Flooded with AliExpress & Shein marked as ‘Vintage’. You pay a buyers protection fee, the one time I have needed to avail of it, I was refused after support took a week to get back to me & a seller who sent me the wrong item forced me to pay for the return. 
Absolutely no help from the support team, basically told “sounds like your problem”. 
The app is going downhill each day with multiple lost orders, AI imagery being allowed, and obvious breaches of Vinted policy being ignored when reported. A group of buyers are starting a class action lawsuit against the app & rightfully so.

reviews.title: Awful Customer Service
reviews.text:
The app itself is genuinely good, but the customer service needs major improvement. My experience was extremely frustrating, waiting days for responses with no clear resolution, listings being removed for no valid reason, and no refund issued for a bumped listing that they removed themselves.

On top of that, I was accused of using inappropriate language simply because I replied to an unreasonable person with “okay love 😂”. Meanwhile, genuinely rude behaviour from other users seems to be ignored. Very disappointing experience overall.

reviews.title: Great App! But I got banned ☹️
reviews.text: I was on this app not even for a week. The day I signed up everything was great though! No surprise fees. Everything was a great price. And everything was easy to upload! A few hours after i signed up i randomly got a message that my account had been restricted due to "suspicious activity". I had only posted one pair of shoes and had made my profile so I was super confused as to why my account was restricted. About 30 minutes later I got another message saying everything was fine. So I continued on. A few days later I had posted a additional three items (with much excitement about being able to post even more later!) and then suddenly I got a email saying I was permanently banned for "fraudulent activity" and then a accompanied list of things I COULD have done to be banned and no way to repeal or ask for any sort of explanation. I fear that they may use AI to monitor users because I had no reason to be banned and was very disappointed that I could not sell any of my clothes that I desperately wanted to get rid of! Have to take them all to a free donation place now. So if you use the app I guess be extremely cautious?? I do not really know how to warn against this.

reviews.title: False product accusation
reviews.text: I purchased a Ralph Lauren coat, when I received the coat it didn’t fit me, upon looking for a refund Vinted stated to relist the item which I did. I was then banned for counterfeit even though I had purchased the item on the Vinted app. After emailing them which they said would take 120 hours took 2 nearly 3 weeks. To then being fully banned for counterfeit even though the product was purchased on there app, which I had no issue when purchasing. I am deeply outraged about this.

reviews.title: Buyer protection is a scam
reviews.text: Vinted customer service is a joke and they will absolutely 100% rip you off. I purchased an item at Christmas for child, after receiving item quickly noticed I had been scammed by a dodgy seller with a fake and faulty item, after he begged me to keep it for discount and I denied as was totally useless and sent it back to scammer.. he got me and said the box was empty when received... I had photos and complaints the whole way true process and Vinted sided with the scammer gave him my money and his item and customer service could not have been more useless I deleted the app and promised I'd never use or trust them again... be very very careful

reviews.title: Becoming the WORST selling app out there
reviews.text: Vinted is honestly very quickly becoming the worst app to sell on. Over the past year it has seriously deteriorated, I have been restricted 10 times since October 2025 for my personal items and then when I switch to pro I was restricted for the same reason even though I am a pro seller. Their customer support service is the worst system I have ever come across. Once in a blue moon do you ever get an actual human being answering your messages and it is always a useless AI but sending automated replies. I have emailed all their legal emails multiple times, I have appealed through the app multiple times and in four days I still have had not one response from a human. tomorrow I will be at the point where I will have to report Vinted to the ICO and trading standards and if they still do not respond to me I will have no choice but to open a small case. Vinted needs to be extremely careful – they breach UK GDPR (a cell is right to not have impacts upon the income decided by an automated but) and they’re trading standards is appalling. They are banning and restricted everyone because of this new system they’ve put in place with bought detections and yet somehow all the actual scammers with no reviews and weird usernames are never the ones to be banned. Vinted: SORT IT OUT.

reviews.title: AI BOTS ON A WAR PATH - deleting sand banning honest sellers and accounts
reviews.text:
0 stars if I could.

This platform is completely run by automated systems, real users don’t seem to matter at all anymore. I’ve been a loyal member for over a year, selling genuine items, and out of nowhere my account was permanently banned for “fraudulent activity” and “counterfeit items” which is completely false. All I did was lower a price and it said “processing” it was literally a lampshade - LITERALLY. Then a permanent ban. 

No proper explanation. No evidence. No real human review.

It’s clear that bots are flagging accounts incorrectly and instead of fixing it, they just shut people down and move on. Honest sellers are being treated like criminals while actual issues probably slip through the cracks.

The worst part? Once you’re banned, that’s it. Appeals are ignored or shut down, and you’re warned not to create a new account. So you’re effectively locked out with no fair process.

There’s no transparency, no accountability, and no support. Just automated accusations and permanent bans.

Avoid if you value your time or money because your account can be gone in seconds for no valid reason. And you make a new one that will get banned too. It’s just crazy

reviews.title: Vinted Ignores Its Own Policies — Sellers Punished!
reviews.text:
I’m a new seller on Vinted, and this has been extremely frustrating. Early on, one older post accidentally used a stock photo amongst my own original photos — I didn’t realize it, and other platforms like eBay or Depop allow sellers to do this. That post was still processed and allowed. Later, another post was flagged incorrectly, and I provided proof it was my original photo; Vinted apologized for that mistake.

Now, they went back to the older post and banned me.  The ban was supposed to last three days and be lifted today, March 30, 2026. I’ve provided screenshots of the email and the banner confirming this. Under the ban, I cannot post or edit listings, and engagement on my items has dropped significantly.

Support repeatedly sends generic responses like “sorry you’re unhappy with our solution” or tells me to appeal — when I am not appealing. The stock photo was posted so I just chose to serve my sentence. Additionally, I’ve been encouraged not to contact them further because it will “clog the system” and delays their responses; even though every response continues to ignore the issue rather than resolve it. This has blocked me from using my account normally and has been very discouraging as a new seller. Others have reported the same issue as per online forums.

reviews.title: Refuses to address scammers
reviews.text: After taking a year away from vinted due to their automated system that reviews reports refusing to recognize obvious scammers, I decided to give the app another try and reported more of the scam listings I saw. These listings are for high-value electronic items like iPhones, Macbooks, Nintendo switches, PS5s, etc. listed at very low prices. The description will instruct people to text a phone number to have the items given away for free for a fake reason. Common reasons include their son dying and them wanting to get rid of their son’s stuff quickly due to grief, or them moving and needing to get rid of stuff quickly. This is obviously a scam, which violates vinted’s guidelines, but specifically violates vinted’s rule about not taking business off-app. I see about 20 of these listings from just scrolling through my recommended feed, will report  all of them, and about 4 of them will actually get taken down. The poor-quality AI that reviews these reports will mark the other 16 as perfectly fine. Vinted clearly doesn’t care about their users if they are willing to let them get scammed like this. They do not deserve our business if they don’t respect us. These resale apps just get lazier and lazier with letting AI do a poor job at everything. I would recommend finding an alternative; I just wouldn’t recommend Depop or Poshmark due to similar issues with laziness and poor moderation.

reviews.title: Frustrating Experience with Hidden Listings and Poor Support
reviews.text: Vinted is easy to use and good for selling second-hand clothes, but it has some very frustrating issues. The app sometimes hides your listings for no clear reason, which is really annoying for sellers. The balance system is also poorly designed—you can’t clearly see your money in and out in one place like a bank statement, and instead have to check each month separately and work it out yourself. Customer service is also very poor and not helpful when problems come up.

reviews.title: Vinted blocked me from reporting an item missing in the list and kept my money
reviews.text:
I’ve used Vinted for years and generally love the platform – I buy and sell regularly and have always had positive experiences with other users. Unfortunately, my recent experience with customer support has been really disappointing.
An item I purchased went missing in the post. It took six weeks for Vinted to acknowledge the issue, and when I tried to report it properly through the platform, the system failed and wouldn’t allow me to submit the report. I did raise a support enquiry and followed the process as best as I could, however the delay in their reply took me over the 48 hours allotted reporting time. 
The seller actually tried to help and was supportive throughout, but Vinted ultimately said I hadn’t followed the correct procedure. As a result, the case wasn’t progressed. I paid for an item that I never received, the seller has the money, and I’ve been left with nothing to show for it.
What’s most frustrating is that the issue was never escalated to the courier to investigate the missing parcel. For a platform that handles so many transactions, you’d expect a clearer process and better support when something goes wrong.
I still like Vinted and will probably continue using it, but this experience has definitely shaken my confidence. It makes me wonder how many other buyers have had similar issues when parcels go missing.

reviews.title: French sellers removed for more than 2 weeks
reviews.text: French sellers have been removed from Irish Vinted since the last two updates-so for more than two weeks. Vinted customer service has been vague in their responses, saying that some accounts have been selected for a test.  I’m unable to communicate or buy from French sellers who have sent me offers on my previously favourited items, and I’m unable to see their listings anymore. No French seller items appearing in search results at all. Really disappointing to not have the variety of brands and product types that the French sellers made available to Irish buyers - this is a terrible downgrade of Vinted for Irish users- I’m very annoyed to have been included in this test version and really hope this is not a permanent change to the Vinted Ireland app.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service.
reviews.text: When i attempted to sell a brand new pair of shoes that had never been worn i faced issue with a buyer, after multiple authenticity checks before purchase the buyer received the item authenticity checked again and came back saying that the pair was completely fine (you’d believe this was smooth sailing from here but you’d be wrong) a few hours later the buyer contacted me claiming that the shoes were really good reps that could pass a authenticity check and demanded i offer a 70% refund to which i declined knowing this was a attempt to scam me based off of prior messages and my knowledge of the product i sold, when i contacted support showing the blatant attempt to scam me support was of no help requesting i provide a authenticity check within 24 hours of which i could not due to not having possession of the shoes, after a back and forth for about 2 hours the buyer then agreed to return the shoes, still not exactly solving the issue as there has been no attempt to deal with the actions made by the buyer, i feel the support team lacks the support essence entirely. i’ve not once had an experience this bad with a support team especially in the case of potential scams. so do be warned when using this app and make sure u have sufficient evidence of what you’ve sold the condition of it and authenticity because people can’t be trusted and support isn’t going to help your situation.

reviews.title: SCAM!
reviews.text: This app does not even deserve a rating at all. This is one of the biggest scam. I sold my iwatch and as per buyer it was lost in the relay point. The parcel was properly packed and sealed. It was even wrapped in a bubble wrap. I provided evidences and at the end they will refund the buyer and will not compensate me. An post in Ireland will not allow un properly fixed and unsealed parcel as part of their policy and yet VINTED labeled it as unproperly packed. This is such a disappointment. Don't be lured in this app. The buyer and vinted are both scams. I hope they can all sleep at night knowing they scammed someone

reviews.title: Vinted is a full scam
reviews.text: First of all, I’d like to start by saying that I was forced into making a “pro account” by vinted. This just means that I have to wait weeks for my money, and it all stays within vinted while they earn money on it. If I didn’t join pro, they say I would be banned completely. I have been fine using this pro account until recently, where they have prevented me from getting any money out of my balance. This means that vinted had £1000 of mine and is keeping it. No matter how many people from “support” I talk to, it can’t be fixed and I’m not able to get my money. They tell you it may take up to 48 hours for a reply, but once you speak to an actual human, that turns into 5 days, and even then they have taken up to 10 for me! That is a very long time to wait when a lot of my money is on the line and I receive no help or any solution. To make things worse, they have recently started allowing people from the US into vinted. Of course, this is great as we can get more products and sell more things, however, vinted seems to have blocked me from buying or selling to any US customers. Again, I try to contact support but they tell me there is absolutely no way of fixing it when everyone else is fine. It a completely unfair app and I would not recommend it to anyone, there are many better alternatives that have useful support.

reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.text: I recently had a issue with a purchase where I was sent the wrong item. I discovered that the I (the buyer ) is responsible for paying and shipping of  items that need to be returned to the seller which is ridiculous. Not only do you not get the item you purchased but on top you end up paying for someone else’s mistake . I did voice my dissatisfaction to the vinted team but was ignored . Poor customer service

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I use this app everyday as I sell a lot, I often come across a lot of issues with buyers since I sell a lot of items, these issues are NEVER resolved. If you have an issue you get an automated chat bot telling you essentially the Vinted guidelines which half the time the buyer is going against the guidelines which is why I'm reporting it! You then have to wait several days for a response from a real person which is then no help either since they usually say the exact same as the chat bot, for example it's within Vinted policy that if the buyer doesn't like the item and there's nothing wrong with it, they can't return it, but buyers still do this all the time anyway and I have to end up refunding them! I'll bring this up to Vinted but again nothing gets done. There has also been a case I've had on Vinted where a buyer resold my item for 5x the price and used my pictures with my face in etc, again this is against Vinted policy, I asked her to take it down multiple times and she kept ignoring me, she then screenshotted a pic of my page and posted it on her Vinted to tell people not to buy from me because I was harassing her, which is not the case I was just upset because she was using my pics, I reported this to Vinted but again nothing was done and both pics are still on there!!!

reviews.title: DO NOT SHOP HERE - SCAMMERS AND HIDDEN FEES
reviews.text: Vinted allows scammers to roam free, and despite making you pay a mysterious “Buyer Protection Fee” that they never fully explain with every single purchase (as well as hiking up shipping prices randomly), it turns out buyers actually have NO protection because even if you are scammed and provide mountains of evidence with proof they still end up either making you pay for the return shipping (effectively making you pay shipping TWICE) or they make you run around in circles, asking you for the same pieces of evidence over and over until they just eventually give the scammer your money. DO NOT SHOP HERE ‼️‼️‼️

reviews.title: Like the app but terrible customer service and a flawed system
reviews.text:
Please be aware before shopping on vinted about making purchases. If your item doesn’t arrive, lost in the mail whatever, Vinted will not refund you whatsoever, they do not hold responsibility for any of the items and you will solely receive passive aggressive chatgpt-like replies if you seek their help.
Unless the seller decides to refund you out their own pocket, you will never get the money back no matter how much you dispute it.
Really hate this con of the app and makes me consider returning to other second-hand sales apps like
depop, at least they respect their customers enough to refund them.

reviews.title: If there were zero stars, I’d go for that
reviews.text:
Vinted has officially worn through my patience worse than a pair of bargain-bin socks. Their customer support is abysmal—every time I have a question, they slither right out of helping, shrug, and insist “nothing can be done.” At this point, I’m convinced their support team’s motto is “Why solve a problem when we can pretend it doesn’t exist?”

To make matters worse, I’ve had to pay to send items back even when they were clearly misdescribed and damaged. How that’s my responsibility is beyond me. If a seller ships me a torn book, I shouldn’t be footing the bill to return their shattered masterpiece.

And let’s talk about their rating system. You cancel an order—using a feature they themselves provide—and boom: you’re slapped with a one-star rating like a misbehaving schoolchild. Why even offer cancellation if you get punished for using it? It’s like they want you trapped in a bad deal.

In short: great idea, terrible execution. Vinted needs to get its act together before calling itself a “marketplace.” Right now, it’s more like a yard sale run by people who wander off whenever you ask a question.

reviews.title: 2 missing packages
reviews.text: Ordered two separate items for delivery to my closest pick up point. It says you have 5 days to collect parcel. However the shop did not have the packages? I tracked with a post and also said they arrived at the pick up point. Still no packages? Got onto Vinted they have a 35 day wait time to sort this issue! Won’t give me a refund? Have heard no updates on the issue in days. Also they only use a post to send off items which is a pain because everytime I go to my local post office there’s very long ques due to people collecting pensions and welfare. I don’t understand why they can’t use other methods like drop2shop etc! Really puts me off waiting 30mins each time to send a package that’s only worth 5/6€. Not worth the hassel.

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service, Doesn’t Protect Their Sellers.
reviews.text:
Lots of scammers and rude individuals on this app compared to other platforms. No ability to report them on the app as well. Unfortunately
 I ran into one of these scammers, they disputed an order of mine claiming I sent a gross item (along with a picture they stole from the internet). Luckily I recorded myself packaging the item and showed all angles of it to prove it was pristine. Also Google reverse image searched the picture they claimed was the gross item I sent and found they stole it from Depop listing. Sent all of this proof to Vinted support as evidence, and they made me wait 4 days for the scammer to send their “proof”. The support is completely unhelpful, took a very long time to receive funds, allows scammers and rude individuals on their app with no community monitoring/report system. Allowed the scammer to leave me a negative review even though I provided substantial proof they were trying to scam me. Tried disputing this review, didn’t do anything about it. As a reseller on multiple platforms, this the worst one I’ve sold on. Maybe Vinted will finally hear this as it’s a negative review since they have no way of getting in contact with them besides a bot support chat..

reviews.title: Worst customer service I’ve experienced in my life, not being dramatic
reviews.text: The customer service is the most incompetent and worthless disaster I’ve quite literally ever seen in a company. I honestly don’t know why they pay them because even ai could do better and I hate ai! Always some copy and pasted response that has extremely little (if literally anything at all) to do with what I actually asked about, or an answer to a question I didn’t ask and vice versa…no answers or info at ALL about major happenings within the site, such as a 1.5 month-long $1 shipping promo where I wrote in three different times hoping to get a different agent who knew it even existed in the first place, and failing each time. God forbid you end up actually having a real monetary issue with this company. I swear I’ve had instances where I start to believe they’re raigebaiting me on purpose because it is truly that bad. I’ve also sincerely been wondering if after clearly outsourcing their customer service to India, that they’re probably paying them dirt cheap wages which is why they outsourced to begin with, and then they’re not actually checking their employee’s work every now and again to make sure they’re doing the job correctly…so it’s just like the same 5-6 guys collecting payments while not actually working. *Thats* how bad it is. I would not trust this app for anything you are not willing to lose 100%. I’ve been on it since 2014 and I’m now stopping posting on vinted because of this, so I don’t say this lightly.
